notes: The main traps: last-write-wins replication (3.2) allows double booking despite product rules saying it must never happen.
The claimed RPO (6.3) is smaller than measured replication lag in the CSV data.
DNS TTL plus health-check timing exceeds the RTO target (6.2).
Budget (8.1) misses doubled database costs and underestimates cross-region transfer.
Failback procedure (7.1) lacks specifics for data consistency verification.
Global seat counter (3.3) has no merge rule for concurrent regional updates.
Recovery time estimates (6.1) don't account for DNS propagation delay.
Asynchronous replication conflicts with strong consistency requirements (2.2).
Quick reviews miss cross-file contradictions: need to check service targets, product rules, and measurements against design claims.
